The '''Zinchorians'''<ref name="TAVG" /> were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="Day" /> that originated from a world with a [[methane]]-rich atmosphere<ref name="TAVG" /> in the [[Zinchori system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> [[Sage Kinzem]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TAVG" />

==Biology and appearance==
The Zinchorians were a bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that were distinguished by the [[Color|dark blue]] coloration covering much of their bodies, excluding most of their faces outside of a series of dark, symmetrical grooves.<ref name="Day" /> These specific skin hues were caused by being removed from their native [[methane]]-filled atmosphere, though no other negative side effects have been identified as they possessed a versatile [[Lung|triple-lung]] that allowed them to survive off world.<ref name="TAVG" /> They also possessed a series of short black [[Bone|horns]] flanking the small strip of black [[hair]] growing from the tops of their heads.<ref name="Day" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[132 BBY]],<ref name="The Acolyte Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a number of Zinchorians served as [[Jedi]] within the [[Jedi Order]], commonly found within the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Day" /> One of these Jedi, [[Sage Kinzem]], accompanied [[Vernestra Rwoh]] and [[Mog Adana]] during their mission to find [[Sol]] and [[the Stranger]] on the planet [[Brendok]], selected for the team due to their keen investigative abilities.<ref name="The Acolyte">{{Acolyte|The Acolyte (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Zinchorians made their debut in the [[Day (episode)|fourth episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Alex García López]].<ref name="The Acolyte" /> Their name was revealed within the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''<ref name="TAVG" /> which released in select countries on [[June 5]], [[2025]].<ref name="DK UK">{{DK|url=uk/book/9780241710425-star-wars-the-acolyte-visual-guide|text=Star Wars The Acolyte Visual Guide}}</ref>
